newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian works minister under investigation - lawyer.
newsitem.headline: Italian works minister under investigation - lawyer.

text.p: Italian Public Works Minister Antonio Di Pietro is under preliminary investigation by magistrates in this northern Italian city, his lawyer confirmed on Thursday.

Massimo Dinoia, lawyer for former graft-busting magistrate Di Pietro, told reporters he had no knowledge of the allegations involving Di Pietro and no date had been set for any possible questioning of the minister.
Dinoia said he had talked with Di Pietro but gave no indications of what they had discussed.

Earlier, Italian newspapers said the former magistrate, who became a folk hero for his part in exposing a nationwide web of corruption and graft, was under investigation for corruption, with several unspecified allegations being considered.
However, Prime Minister Romano Prodi said earlier he had confidence in Di Pietro, whom he brought into his cabinet after winning elections in April this year.

Di Pietro has already been the target of a probe by Brescia magistrates investigating allegations of corruption and of profiting from holding a public office. The charges against him were dropped in April.
